title: Nine-Tailed Demon Sorceress
description: A female demon with nine large white and red fox tails leaps dynamically in a dark forest. She wields a massive glowing red sword in one hand and a swirling blue magical orb chained to her other hand, surrounded by floating red petals, blue energy, and small shadowy figures on the ground below.
